requirements.text: The app must provide real-time notifications for transactions.
The app must allow users to freeze their card easily without needing to call customer support.
The app must provide a monthly spending breakdown categorized by different expenses.
The app must allow users to set budgets for different categories and provide alerts when limits are approaching.
The app must support biometric login options such as fingerprint or face recognition.
The app must allow users to send money to friends using their phone numbers.
The app must provide a modern and intuitive user experience.
The app must be user-friendly and smooth in functionality.
